headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: MMC gears up to improve traffic flow in Secunderabad.
Telangana BJP has sought Congress’ stance on ‘regime change’ calls.
South African anti-migrant protests turn violent, government blames disinformation.
Police send notices to students, CJP supporters ahead of October 10 Delhi protest.
bullets_ur: MMC ne Secunderabad mein traffic ki rawani behtar banane ki tayyari shuru kar di.
Telangana BJP ne 'regime change' ke mutalibaat par Congress se moaqqaf talab kar liya.
Chattisgarh se CRPF ke 7,000 ahlkaar wapas bula liye gaye.

Police ne October 10 ke Delhi ehtijaj se qabal talba aur CJP supporters ko notices bhaij diye.
